# AdaptiveDeltaPulseFrequencyEncoding

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A mixed encoding scheme that combines adaptive delta modulation with pulse frequency modulation to convert continuous bio-signals into sparse event-based spikes. Enables energy-efficient, low-latency neural signal acquisition for in-network neuromorphic processing, reducing data volume while preserving signal dynamics.
